Traffic-light heatmap of per-sample quality sub-scores

Source: R/plots.R
plot_quality_heatmap.Rd

Renders the score_<metric> columns of a score_sample_quality() table as a samples × metrics tile heatmap, filled on a red→amber→green 0–100 gradient and annotated with the rounded sub-score. Metric rows are labelled with their human-readable names and QC samples are marked with a trailing asterisk.

Usage

plot_quality_heatmap(scores, thresholds = quality_thresholds_default())

Arguments

scores

Output of score_sample_quality().

thresholds

Scoring table used to label/order the metric rows (default quality_thresholds_default()).

Value

A ggplot2 tile heatmap.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_quality_heatmap(score_sample_quality(pep_all, c(8, 13), "MHC1"))
} # }
